rules.condition: Strict-Transport-Security is missing, invalid, or has max-age=0
rules.evidence: final URL and header presence; no response body

rules.applies_to: HTTPS responses with a readable certificate
rules.condition: certificate expires within tls_expiry_warning_days; expired certificates are critical
rules.measurement_error: no finding; reported as a source/measurement error

rules.applies_to: HTTPS responses setting an explicitly configured session cookie
rules.condition: configured cookie name is set without the Secure attribute
rules.evidence: cookie name and attributes only; cookie values are never stored

excluded: full Nuclei template language and template updates
browser JavaScript crawling and headless checks
